# DesiDime

> > India's largest deals aggregator platform, curating coupons and cashback offers across e-commerce, banking, fintech, and lifestyle categories.

DesiDime is a comprehensive deals and coupons platform for Indian online shoppers, featuring real-time offers from major retailers like Amazon, Flipkart, and Myntra. The platform organizes deals across 16+ product categories and integrates with digital payment systems, banks, and fintech services to maximize savings.

## Key Topics

- Amazon
- Flipkart
- Cashback Offers
- Coupons & Discounts
- UPI Payments
- Digital Wallets
- Banking Partners (HDFC, SBI, ICICI, Axis)
- E-commerce Deals
- Payment Apps (Google Pay, PhonePe, BHIM)
- Travel & Hotels
- Food & Beverage
- Electronics & Mobiles
- Fashion & Apparel
- Deal Community
- Discount Codes

## Core Platform

- [Online Shopping India | Best Deals | Top Deals Online - Desidime](https://www.desidime.com): DesiDime homepage: India's deals aggregator for online shopping
- [All Groups with Trending and Popular Offers & Deals](https://www.desidime.com/groups): DesiDime groups directory: browse all deal categories and communities
